display_title: When the Mad Dog Bites the Leash
description:
The noble daughter of house Dew, decorated knight of the Asellan kingdom, and undefeated warrior... is the second prince Ethan's 'mad dog,' Adrian Dew. Her foul mouth and fouler personality may have been the cause of countless headaches to her father, prince Ethan, the king, the princess... basically everyone she came into contact with, but Adrian is fiercely loyal.

Determined to ensure the throne for Ethan instead of his powerful, well-backed sister, princess Della, Adrian fights tooth and nail to win as many victories in battle in his name. But not even her prince can defend her for what she did in her last battle in the rocky plains of the East.

"You will assist the regent of Jolkyacarta for five years..." banished in all but name to a newly conquered kingdom, Adrian must serve her sentence before she can return to prince Ethan who is powerless without her. Five years among a different people, different customs, and different god... all of which hate her and her people, Adrian must survive.

Yet one set of eyes regards her with mysterious curiosity.

*"Have I seen you before?... in a dream?"*

(Source: Pocket Comics)
